# The apt packages the Dispatch browser suite installs for Playwright: Playwright's whole
# ubuntu24.04-x64 list less four media packages (gstreamer1.0-libav, gstreamer1.0-plugins-bad,
# gstreamer1.0-plugins-good and libavcodec60). Why those four are dropped, and what that saves,
# is in the head of .github/scripts/playwright-install.sh, the script that reads this file.
#
# One script reads it, that one, which the "Install the lane's Playwright browsers" step of
# .github/workflows/dispatch-browser.yaml's shard job and of its alone job both run; its `grep`
# drops these `#` lines and the blank ones. That filter is load-bearing: the shell reads this
# file, not apt, and `$packages` is left unquoted there and splits into words, so a comment line
# reaches apt as one package name per word. That script then holds this list against
# Playwright's own with .github/scripts/playwright-deps-current.sh.
#
# On a Playwright upgrade, re-derive the list as the union of the `tools`, `chromium`, `firefox`
# and `webkit` entries of the ubuntu24.04-x64 table in playwright-core's lib/coreBundle.js, less
# those four. Deriving it at run time by subtracting one apt closure from the other does not work
# and must not be written: the two closures share 35 packages Playwright's own list names or
# needs, and the subtraction leaves WebKit unable to launch.
fonts-freefont-ttf
